skill.summary: Track OpenClaw tasks on NextCloud Deck board. Auto-add tasks to Queue, move through states.

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 0.1.1

- Added version number to SKILL.md header.
- Introduced new "monitor" command for automated heartbeat/status updates and chat notifications during long-running tasks.
- Improved documentation for AI users on handling complex multi-line descriptions using temporary files to avoid shell issues.
- No code changes; documentation update only.
